84: No dashboard builder exists. The dashboards are the same for every user.
187: No fuel log: litres, rate, odometer and consumption figures are not recorded or calculated. Fuel can only be recorded as an ordinary expense line under the Fuel ledger.
188: No fuel card records or statement reconciliation. The vehicle register holds a fuel card number as text only.
189: No mileage claim and no rate per kilometre.
190: No toll register and no statement import. A toll is an ordinary expense line; the vehicle register holds the FASTag number as text.
206: No daily allowance calculation. A trip holds a daily allowance amount typed by a person; nothing is worked out from grade, city or duration.
208: Claims and advances are recorded in the company's own currency only; there is no exchange rate and no base-currency equivalent. A trip can be marked as foreign travel, nothing more.
218: Reading a receipt from a photograph is not built. A photograph can be attached to a claim; every figure is typed by a person.
221: Card transactions are not recorded, so there is nothing to mark as unexplained. No notification or escalation exists.
222: No PERSONAL / RECOVERABLE marking on a card expense and no employee receivable created from it.
233: No register of uniforms, safety equipment or other issued items exists. A Group Super Admin could define a register kind for it; none is supplied.
245: Office operating cost is not calculated and is not divided by headcount. People cost states that shared costs such as rent and electricity are not allocated.
261: No prepaid schedule. A 'Prepaid Expenses' ledger exists in the chart template; recognition of expense is by hand-written journal, and recognised and remaining amounts per item are not tracked.
270: No daily summary of yesterday's expenses.
276: No offline capture. The application needs a connection.
277: No location can be attached to an expense or a trip. The code contains no location tracking of any kind.
302: No office cost view exists. Entries tagged to an office can be listed in the ledger, but no total office operating cost and no breakdown by type of cost is calculated.
344: No cancellation loss report. A loss can be recorded as an exceptional-transaction register item; nothing adds them up by type.
418: No forecast is stored, so there is nothing to compare with actual figures. Forward is recalculated from the records each time it is opened.
425: No projected profit and loss. Forward projects cash only.
434: No management pack is generated. The statements exist as separate reports from phase 1; nothing assembles them, and a forecast section does not exist.
461: No calculation of provisions or expected credit loss. A doubtful-debt register item only records a provision figure entered by a person.
473: Forecast final cost is not calculated. A work order holds an 'estimated cost to complete' typed by a person.
486: No board pack is generated. The statements exist as separate reports from phase 1; management commentary, major investments and a forecast section do not exist.
490: No one-click document pack. Each report is opened and exported on its own.
517: Reading document contents is not built. Only the kind of document is suggested, from the file name, labelled SUGGESTION; every other field is typed by a person.
519: No e-mail intake. A saved e-mail file can be uploaded by a person.
571: Manufacturing is not built: no bill of materials, no raw material or finished goods stage, no work in progress, no production order, no consumption, labour, machine cost, overhead, scrap, wastage or yield. The list of capabilities says so under Inventory.
580: Not calculated. No project budget, committed cost per project or forecast final cost exists.
645: No boardroom mode. Home has a Simple presentation level, which changes wording only and is not an executive presentation of approved figures.
701: No view of future exposure by currency. Invoices and purchase orders are converted at their recorded rate; register items, advances and claims carry a currency but no rate.
719: No comparison of budget, actual, committed, estimated remaining and forecast final cost for a project. A work order item shows what was posted against it and an estimate to complete typed by a person; nothing is calculated from them.
720: No warning of falling margins. Gross and net margin are shown for a period in the phase 1 reports; no comparison over time and no margin by project, product or customer exists.
817: No forecast is stored, so forecast accuracy cannot be tracked.
818: No register of assumptions. Assumptions are fixed sentences shown with each projection and warning; they cannot be changed, and no history of changes exists.
1208: Software cost is not attributed to employees. A subscription holds 'used by' as text.
1210: Vehicle cost is not attributed to employees; there are no allocation rules.
1218: No trend or comparison of people cost across months, quarters or years, or against budget. People cost shows one selected period at a time and a separate forecast.
1221: Vacancies are not tracked. There is no record of a planned role without a named person, and no vacancy cost.
1249: Sensitivity analysis is not built. No what-if modelling exists.
1279: No warning of stale data. There is no bank feed or other integration whose last update could be shown, and reports carry no such mark.
1287: No comparison of repair against replacement exists. Maintenance events with their cost are listed on the asset; replacement cost, downtime, remaining life and a NUMI summary are not built.
1324: An employee belongs to one company and the cost is charged there. No allocation of one person's cost across companies exists.
1325: An asset belongs to one company and its department must be of that company. Use by another company cannot be recorded.
1327: No allocation of one contract across companies.
1339: No corporate family tree. Companies belong to one group as a flat list with no holding or subsidiary relation; only the units inside one company are shown as a tree (Genesis).
1433: No recovery process is defined or tested in the project. No live account exists yet.
1590: No mobile scan: no crop, deskew, enhancement or extraction. A photograph is stored as it is uploaded.
1595: No detection or splitting of several invoices in one PDF.
1597: NUMI does not suggest routing of documents. A person classifies and links each document.
1759: Nested dropdowns are not built. A dropdown is one flat list of options.
1760: Dependent dropdowns are not built. No field changes its options according to another field.
1762: No approval step exists before a new dropdown option becomes active.
1763: No form builder exists. There is no drag and drop of fields.
1783: No status builder exists. The statuses of every record are fixed in the program and the database.
1785: Transaction types cannot be created by an administrator. The Transaction Centre has a fixed list.
1801: No report builder exists, so custom fields, kinds and paths cannot be added to a report.
1803: Calculators are fixed. An administrator cannot define a formula calculator.
1805: No dashboard builder exists for departments or scenarios.
1807: No department workspace exists. Ledger entries can be filtered by department; there is no department home page.
1810: No menu builder exists. The navigation is fixed and shows what each person's permissions allow.
1812: Menus are not configured per company. A menu entry is hidden only when the person lacks the permission for it in the selected companies.
1813: No workspace or menu per department.
1815: Permissions cannot be set per custom object. The register permissions apply to every register kind alike.
1819: Document types are a fixed list in the program. An administrator cannot add one.
1826: No department can be cloned. A department is an organisation unit created one at a time in the Genesis Builder › Structure (level, code, name, the unit it reports to, confidentiality); it carries no configuration of its own and cannot be copied or edited there. Cloning a company (Companies › Clone configuration) copies its active units, departments among them, into the new company. The Scenario Studio clones a workflow, not a department.
1827: A path cannot be cloned. No copy action exists on a register item.
1843: No rule that shows or requires one field depending on another.
1844: No automations exist. Nothing runs on a trigger; a person starts every action.
1847: No rule engine (when, if, then, else) exists.
1850: A path does not invoke a workflow. Advances and claims follow the same fixed workflow whatever path they are linked to.
1865: Workflows of the Scenario Studio are made active and versioned (Phase 3), but NUMI explains no change of configuration to the people it affects, and nobody is told when a workflow is published.
1866: Display names of concepts such as Department cannot be renamed by an administrator.
1869: Reading document contents is not built, so an uploaded invoice cannot fill any field.
1886: There is no Department Admin and nothing is configured per department. Roles and permissions are held per company, not per department; the Department Head role reads, requests and approves, and configures nothing. Custom fields, expense categories, approval rules and workflows are defined for the group or for a company.
1890: No API for custom fields or custom objects is offered.
1892: No import maps columns to custom fields. Imports take bank statements, journals, opening balances and the trial balance of an earlier system (Phase 3), mapping their columns to the fields of those records only.
1893: Custom field values and the fields of a register kind are not included in exports.
1894: Custom field values and the fields of a register kind are not searched.
1899: The comparison reads eight fixed chains (purchase, sale, advance, fixed asset, cash box, stock, bank, verification sheet). A workflow of the Scenario Studio, a custom field or a register kind added by an administrator is not read by it, and the Capabilities list says so. A step of a workflow can point to a case under Reality, and a case of kind 'other' can be opened by hand; neither is a reconciliation.
